description: Controlled model-returned interval fixtures for resolveRayPath. These rows test stage selection, clipping, empty-path, rejection, and boundary-metadata behavior only; geometry-derived intersections are intentionally out of scope.

expectedComparisonPolicy.nonnumeric: Exact structural comparison for object, array, string, boolean, and null expected values. Numeric distance members inside expected objects use the datum units and exact comparison unless a row-level tolerance says otherwise.
